resources.name: UNHCR HELP — South Africa
resources.address: Countrywide online guidance — representative map point at Pretoria, not a service address
resources.summary: Official information for refugees, asylum-seekers, and stateless people in South Africa, including rights, contacts, and locally available support.
resources.availabilityNote: This is countrywide guidance, not a walk-in office. Eligibility and available programs depend on personal circumstances and current local capacity.
resources.sourceDetail: UNHCR lists this country in its official HELP directory. The live country page is the authority for languages, contacts, eligibility, and current services.
resources.coverageNote: Countrywide guidance; the globe marker is geographic context only.

resources.name: Social relief of distress
resources.accessType: Apply at SASSA office or online
resources.costNote: The service is provided for free.
resources.address: Nationwide service covering all of South Africa
resources.summary: The Social Relief of Distress provides temporary assistance to individuals and families facing dire material needs who are unable to meet their most basic needs. It offers food parcels, vouchers, or cash to those experiencing emergencies, lacking income, or awaiting other grants.
resources.availabilityNote: Temporary assistance usually for up to three months, which may be extended for another three months. Requires proof of dire material need or emergency.
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official South African government page states that the Social Relief of Distress provides temporary assistance in the form of food parcels, vouchers, or cash, and explicitly notes "The service is free.".
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Nationwide service covering all of South Africa. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
